fns.desc: kay_create_mka's opening wpa_printf dereferences kay->if_name (%s) before the NULL check on kay two lines later (if (!kay || !ckn || !cak) at ~3679); if kay could genuinely be NULL at a call site this would crash first. Current callers (wpa_auth_kay.c:442/484, wpas_kay.c:359/407) always pass hapd->kay/wpa_s->kay without an explicit prior NULL check, though kay is expected to be set once MACsec is configured — real risk is low but the ordering is a latent bug regardless of exploitability.
